_comment: Phase D2 observations for the 7 entries in the score 20-30 range. Threshold raised from 20 to 30 after Phase D's 0x4d8ea false-positive showed that score-only criteria (without caller analysis) can miss family-confusion cases. These 7 entries were originally auto_threshold but are now manually verified with full caller + callee + asm evidence.

00047328.key_instructions: PUSH 0x54604 (static struct tm*); PUSH time arg; CALL _gmtime; thin wrapper
00047328.notes: Watcom gmtime(t) is a 2-arg wrapper around _gmtime(t, &static_tm). No callers in FD2 — game does not use UTC time. Static buffer at 0x54604 in DGROUP.

000462a2.key_instructions: If arg2 (DOS error flag) == 0, return success (do nothing); else PUSH arg1, arg2, CALL _dosretax to map and set errno
000462a2.notes: Standard Watcom _dosret0: 'DOS-call return helper for status==0 path'. If carry-flag was clear (status=0), no-op return; else delegate to _dosretax which calls _set_errno. No direct callers because it's typically inlined or referenced via the DOS-call macro expansion in Watcom system-call wrappers. body 24 fits.

00045d4b.key_instructions: Compute stack frame size (round up to 4-byte align), reserve via SUB ESP, init stream threshold, push (argv, argc) from globals, call fd2_main(argc, argv), push retval and JMP exit
00045d4b.notes: Classic Watcom __CMain entry sequence. Sole caller is crt_dos_main_bootstrap — the LE startup glue. Calls user main (fd2_main) and exits with its return value. body 79 fits.

0004cbdd: FCHS
0004cbdf: FCOMPP

0004cbe7: JZ 0x0004cbef
0004cbed: MOV AL,0x3
0004cbef: FINIT
0004cbf2: WAIT
0004cbf3: FLDCW word ptr [ESP]
0004cbf6: XCHG word ptr [ESP],AX
0004cbfa: POP AX
0004cbfc: RET
0004cbd0.key_instructions: FINIT; FLD1/FLDZ/FDIVP (1.0/0.0 -> +Inf); FLD ST0/FCHS/FCOMPP (compare +Inf vs -Inf for FPU type detection); FSTSW + SAHF; return AL = 2 or 3 (FPU type code); FINIT + FLDCW (restore control word)
0004cbd0.notes: Watcom __init_80x87: FPU detection probe. Generates +Inf and -Inf via 1.0/0.0 and FCHS, then FCOMPP detects whether FPU treats them as equal (8087 quirk) or distinct (287/387). Returns FPU type code. Caller is __init_8087 — exact init chain position. body 45 fits.

00036fcc.notes: Standard fopen wrapper that delegates to _fsopen with default share mode. 17 callers covering all FD2 file I/O surfaces (chapter loading, save/load, AIL audio, animation/portrait files). body 21 fits.

000460d5.key_instructions: Skip if FPU-flag global at 0x527f4 already set; FNINIT; FNSTCW [ESP]; check AH==3 (287/387 with both control/status visible); if FPU detected, CALL __init_8087 to setup; record FPU presence in globals 0x527f4 / 0x527f5
000460d5.notes: Watcom __chk8087: lazy FPU detection + init. FNINIT/FNSTCW probe + control word inspection (AH=3 means present). Calls __init_8087 (which itself calls __init_80x87) when FPU found. No direct callers — invoked indirectly via the FPU init chain hooked at startup. body 63 fits.
